source_issue.title: Library Upgrades for the next major (19).

summary_markdown:
```markdown
## What this issue is about
This issue addresses the need to upgrade some outdated libraries used in Volto, such as `react-intl` and `redux`. The goal is to ensure that Volto uses maintained versions of these foundational libraries.

## What needs to be done
- Upgrade `react-intl` and `redux` to their latest maintained versions.
- Adjust the codebase as needed to accommodate changes in these libraries.
- Evaluate if we need to maintain current tooling related to localization (using .po files).

## Helpful background
The discussion includes a specific PLIP related to `react-intl` that may require coordination. The upgrades aim to enhance functionality and stability but may involve some adjustments to existing code.

## Good first steps
1. Familiarize yourself with the relevant documentation for new contributors: [Contributing to Plone](https://6.docs.plone.org/contributing/index.html) and [Contributing to Volto](https://6.docs.plone.org/contributing/volto.html).
2. Review the existing library usage in the project to identify the necessary changes.
3. Consider reaching out to the community for guidance and support if you have questions.
4. Document your findings and any changes you make for future contributors.
```
